three escapes to the Nordhavn line

findings.why: No controlled record shows an approval or release of Fonderia Pellice (SUP-H) for HB-620 delivered to Beinasco (PLT-BEI) for the customer. The meeting only says the audit and PPAP must still pass, and the documents do not show the result. The customer is inferred from the 8D, which names the Nordhavn line (CUST-NOR). Because no record covers this part, plant and customer, absence cannot be read as 'not approved'. A person must confirm whether the audit and PPAP are done and whether a release exists.
